text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aw! And you were so close too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. What are you getting so worked
up about?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We had fun, and that's all that matters.
Well, to
me, anyways.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's getting late. Let's head
back!
